[[File:CoruscantCustomsDroid-LT.png|thumb|right|300px|A customs droid monitoring immigration to the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]].]]
A '''customs droid''' or '''manifest droid''' was a type of [[Class three droid/Legends|class three droid]] assigned to monitor and process visitors, and deal with port authorities. Such droids operated on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
